Sessions

POST /sign-out

Field Value
Needs Nothing; or a session cookie, or a ts_ bearer token. A call with no session answers too
Input None
Answer { ok: true }
Errors None

POST /magic-link/request

Field Value
Needs Nothing
Input JSON { email, next? }
Answer { sent: true }
Errors invalid_body, rate_limited, captcha_required, captcha_failed, captcha_unavailable

GET /magic-link/verify

Field Value
Needs Nothing. The token of the link is the credential
Input Query { token }
Answer A redirect
Errors invalid_token

POST /tokens

Field Value
Needs A session cookie, or a ts_ bearer token. The session is fresh, and the address is verified
Input JSON { name, expiresInDays?, organizationId? }
Answer { token, apiToken }
Errors unauthorized, session_not_fresh, invalid_body, email_unverified, rate_limited, token_limit

GET /tokens/current

Field Value
Needs A tk_ bearer token
Input None
Answer { token }
Errors unauthorized

POST /oauth/revoke

Field Value
Needs Nothing
Input Form { token, client_id? }
Answer An empty 200
Errors invalid_request, rate_limited, unauthorized_client
